raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

Enroll five NVIDIA CI steps in automatic runtime sharding, selecting long jobs from the [duration ranking](https://vllm-ci-dashboard.vercel.app/jobs) over the preceding 12 hours. Batch 5 of five independently based changes.

## Claims

Preserve the test commands and discovery scope while assigning tests using main timing data. Existing AMD fixed shards retain their effective commands and parallelism. Actual wall-time and cost improvements await Buildkite validation.

| Step | 12h median job min | Planned shards | Estimated test min/shard |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| `quantization` | 22.5 | 4 | 15.6, 15.2, 15.2, 15.2 |
| `language-models-test-extended-pooling` | 22.4 | 5 | 16.4, 16.4, 16.4, 16.5, 16.8 |
| `entrypoints-integration-multimodal` | 22.2 | 2 | 10.7, 10.8 |
| `kernels-core-operation-test` | 20.7 | 4 | 13.6, 13.6, 13.6, 13.6 |
| `lm-eval-pcp-4xb200` | 20.6 | 2 | 13.1, 7.2 |


## Validation

- `pre-commit run --files <changed YAML files>`: passed.
- `pytest buildkite/tests/pipeline_generator/test_runtime_shard.py -q` in ci-infra: 24 passed.
- `runtime_shard.plan_step` previews: all five steps produce multiple shards.
- YAML semantic comparison: exactly five enrollments, unchanged commands except NVIDIA fixed-shard arguments, preserved AMD commands and parallelism.
- Buildkite results: current build links, shard/plugin verification, coverage, wall time and cost are in the live validation table below.

Investigate added overhead above 3.5 minutes per shard: `(sum(new shard runtimes) - sum(baseline job runtimes)) / new shard count`. For a fixed-shard baseline, sum all original shards. Also report GPU-minutes using devices per job.


### Baselines

| Step | Build | Wall / total job min | GPU-min | Passed / skipped | Qualification |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---|
| `quantization` | [94505](https://buildkite.com/vllm/ci/builds/94505) | 24.7 / 72.5 | 72.5 | 802 / 98 | recording-free historical main; same job definition and hardware; commits differ |
| `language-models-test-extended-pooling` | [94583](https://buildkite.com/vllm/ci/builds/94583) | 22.4 / 81.4 | 81.4 | 115 / 0 | recording-free historical main; same job definition and hardware; commits differ |
| `entrypoints-integration-multimodal` | [94543](https://buildkite.com/vllm/ci/builds/94543) | 28.6 / 28.6 | 28.6 | 128 / 1 | recording-free historical main; same job definition and hardware; commits differ |
| `kernels-core-operation-test` | [94540](https://buildkite.com/vllm/ci/builds/94540) | 24.3 / 62.0 | 62.0 | 3498 / 132 | recording-free historical main; same job definition and hardware; commits differ |
| `lm-eval-pcp-4xb200` | [94449](https://buildkite.com/vllm/ci/builds/94449) | 20.2 / 20.2 | 80.8 | 3 / 0 | recording-free historical main; same job definition and hardware; commits differ |

Rows marked provisional lack a clean recent baseline; recording-free main controls are in [94583](https://buildkite.com/vllm/ci/builds/94583). Provisional comparisons must not be used to approve cost or coverage. Historical comparisons use the same hardware and job definitions but different commits. Queue time is excluded. Wall time is the maximum individual shard runtime, excluding staggered starts; it is not elapsed Buildkite time.

## Details

Duplicate check: inspected open CI/sharding PRs and excluded Fullgraph, MTEB, DFlash, Entrypoints LLM, multimodal extended generation, MoE refactor DP, and E2E Core work already covered elsewhere. Mamba source-build steps were excluded because every extra shard repeats expensive setup.

Uses existing ci-infra runtime sharding on main (`0b269fb2`); no generator changes are needed. Timing estimates exclude setup. The 12-hour ranking reports each old fixed shard separately, so it is prioritization evidence, not the total-runtime baseline.

AI assistance: Codex prepared the changes and local validation. No model or serving behavior is modified. Remote CI evidence and human review remain pending.

---

<summary> Pull Request Checklist </summary>

- [x] I used vLLM's `/pr-checklist` skill. (Mandatory for agents, optional for humans).
- [x] AI assistance was used during the creation of this PR.

- [x] **Design Fit:** Minimizes impact on core components, reuses existing functionality, and justifies added complexity.
- [ ] **Testing and Validation:** Validates the change and ensures any added tests are meaningful and reliable, with CI coverage or documented CI resource constraints and validation performed outside CI.
- [x] **Code Quality and Style:** Keeps code and comments clear and concise, and updates relevant documentation and examples.
- [ ] **Pull Request Contents:** Includes a brief summary and relevant links, supports claims with evidence, explains root causes and implementation trade-offs, and follows the contributing guide.
</details>

<!-- runtime-shard-results-start -->
## Live validation results

Updated 2026-10-13 21:54 UTC. All five job groups completed; see outcomes and qualifications below.

| Step | State | Wall min (new / main) | Total job min (new / main) | GPU-min (new / main) | Added min/shard | Tests passed / skipped (new vs main) | Coverage |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|---|
| `quantization` | [passed](https://buildkite.com/vllm/ci/builds/94563) | 16.8 / 24.7 | 63.1 / 72.5 | 63.1 / 72.5 | -2.35 | 802 / 92 vs 802 / 98 | matched; plugin verified |
| `language-models-test-extended-pooling` | [passed](https://buildkite.com/vllm/ci/builds/94563) | 18.9 / 22.4 | 62.7 / 81.4 | 62.7 / 81.4 | -3.74 | 115 / 0 vs 115 / 0 | matched; plugin verified |
| `entrypoints-integration-multimodal` | [passed](https://buildkite.com/vllm/ci/builds/94576) | 16.1 / 28.6 | 32.1 / 28.6 | 32.1 / 28.6 | +1.72 | 128 / 1 vs 128 / 1 | matched; plugin verified |
| `kernels-core-operation-test` | [passed](https://buildkite.com/vllm/ci/builds/94563) | 14.2 / 24.3 | 48.1 / 62.0 | 48.1 / 62.0 | -3.45 | 3498 / 130 vs 3498 / 132 | matched; plugin verified |
| `lm-eval-pcp-4xb200` | [passed](https://buildkite.com/vllm/ci/builds/94563) | 12.8 / 20.2 | 21.0 / 20.2 | 83.8 / 80.8 | +0.38 | 3 / 0 vs 3 / 0 | matched; plugin verified |

`lm-eval-pcp-4xb200` has 1 infrastructure failure(s) before execution (`stack_error`), with no start timestamp or measured test runtime. Automatic retries are retained; these attempts are tracked separately from test failures and runtime comparisons.

The initial multimodal API shard exposed an order-dependent assertion in `test_mm_cache_external_injection`: its first LLM initialization reapplies the default logging config, resetting `vllm.propagate=False` after the caplog fixture enables it. The cache-stat log was present in stdout but absent from caplog. This PR restores propagation after engine construction with `monkeypatch`, retaining all metric and log-content assertions. Focused rerun [94576](https://buildkite.com/vllm/ci/builds/94576) passes both shards, with matching aggregate counts and plugin coverage. Added overhead is +1.72 min/shard.

Focused rerun: [94576](https://buildkite.com/vllm/ci/builds/94576) at `503661b1b1a2`.

Skip counts are verified: quantization drops 98 → 92 because two module-level skips were previously repeated in all four fixed shards (8 → 2 collection skips). Core kernels drops 132 → 130 because one module skip was previously repeated in three fixed shards (3 → 1). Passing and all other outcome counts match.

Unaffected jobs retain the results from the original five-job validation build; the follow-up commit changes only the failing job’s environment or test.

+      parallelism: 3
       label: ":amd: (MI300) Core Operation Kernels Shard %N"

       device: mi300_1
